correctness.rationale: An inversion of a vertex subset toggles bipartite edge bits by one outer product over F2, so t inversions iff completed prescribed edge data factor through F2^t. Every deleted 2-factor gives a loopless 2-regular multigraph T of two missing row indices per right column (including 2-cycles with parallel edges); proper 3-colouring assigns distinct nonzero F2^2 vectors to every omitted pair. Kernel basis Q of 2-by-n parity-check matrix restricts invertibly to the n-2 surviving rows of every column, permitting n-2 binary factors for any orientation difference. In Hamiltonian case the n-2 prescribed bits at offsets +2 form a triangular all-diagonal-one rank lower bound for any completion.
